subject: I wasn't going to share this secret date hack
preview_text: I built something extra for you. It wasn't even in the original plan. But it changes how you plan dates.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I was cleaning up some old code for SoulPlan and found a little side project I built months ago. It was just for fun, a personal tool. I never meant to release it.

But then I thought about you and the other couples using the app. This little hack solves the single biggest problem I hear: 'We want a date, but deciding WHAT to do is the hardest part.' It cuts that decision time from 30 minutes of scrolling to about 30 seconds.

So I quietly added it to your app. It's not on the main menu—it's a hidden layer inside the AI date generator. It uses a different, more spontaneous algorithm I was playing with. The ideas it gives are... weirder, more personal, more 'remember that one time' energy.

Open the app right now. Go to 'Generate a Date' and just tap the first category that pops into your head. You'll feel the difference. P.S. This is the only email I'll ever send about this. I might even remove the code next week.
